Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the heads up about the travel hiccup. I saw in the itinerary you have a short overnight layover on the 21st and a tight client schedule the morning after — understood that a single 60–75 minute window won't work.

Two quick options that have worked for other field teams:

1) Split the walkthrough into two focused 30-minute sessions (core product + integrations) on consecutive days so your team can absorb without needing an all-day block.
2) Record the full demo (we'll provide a short highlight cut + timestamps) and follow with a 30-minute live Q&A during the layover or the next morning.

If either works, I can send calendar invites and an agenda. If not, tell me which time zone (you mentioned travelling PST -> CST) and your best windows and I'll loop in Soojin to cover an earlier slot.

Quick ask: do you prefer split sessions or recorded-plus-Q&A?

Cheers,
Jonas

Split sessions sound best — that way our product folks can watch the recording of session 1 if they miss it and still join session 2 live. Can we do:
• Session A — 2026-10-21 11:00 PDT (30m) — core UX + latency/cost overview
• Session B — 2026-10-22 09:30 CDT (30m) — integrations, rollout, and QA

If those times work for Redwood, please send invites. Also would love the short agenda PDF in advance.
